value.pricing.customer_discount: customer_id:str -> Decimal multiplier, 0.90 = 10% off, Decimal(1) = no discount (also returned if unknown customer)
value.tax.compute: customer_id:str, lines:list of (sku:str, line_amount:Decimal) for known SKUs only, discount:Decimal (positive amount) -> (tax_amount:Decimal quantized to 0.01 half-up, rate:Decimal multiplier, 1.0825 = 8.25%, Decimal(1) = 0%; tax.py must return tax 0 and rate 1 for unknown customers)

why: agent3 needs these calls from pricing and tax to implement render_invoice; tax base rules live in tax.py
superseded: agent2 already implemented tax API (sales_tax_cents etc.); adopting it

value.pricing.category: sku:str -> str category used by tax.py (empty string if unknown)
value.pricing.customer_region: customer_id:str -> region code str such as TX (empty string if unknown customer; invoice maps empty to None for tax.py)
value.pricing.customer_discount: customer_id:str -> Decimal multiplier, 0.90 = 10 percent off, Decimal(1) = no discount (Decimal(1) if unknown)
value.tax_api_adopted_from: agent2: sales_tax_cents(region, lines, discount_pct=0) -> int cents; tax_pct_for_region(region) -> Decimal; invoice converts Decimal dollars to int cents and discount multiplier to percent number at the boundary

why: agent3 needs pricing lookups; tax API follows agent2's implemented version
